_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 6,500 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own IPO prospectus); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', with 'approximately 6,500 products in four primary target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own IPO prospectus); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +8% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.30; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY08-FY08 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -11.9%/yr (Q4 FY09 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 26-trading-day median

BULL.desc: EPS -11.9%/yr (no FY08-FY08 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS -11.9%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY08-FY08: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2009-09-11) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (5.3% downside to Bear $15.99 / -18.8% upside to Bull $13.70) | Adj composite 2.54 vs market 1.24: gap +1.30 [UNDERVALUED] | +8% above the EPP floor $15.60 (60x FY09E $0.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: +3.2% total (+1.6%/yr) | At 64.9x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $22.32 sits above the BULL case; net revenue -17.3% YoY in Q3 FY09, forward revenues -13.1% to -10.7% (Q4 FY09 revenue guide (Q3 FY09 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
